"""PLANTED POSITIVE CONTROL -- the shell half of the same defect.

The hook that broke every commit was not Python: it was a `sh` body BUILT
from Python string literals, resolving the settings-home rung into `$_T` and
then running `"$_PY" "$_T"`. An AST-only guard cannot see this, which is
precisely why the shell arm exists. `.py.txt` so nothing else reads it.
"""


def hook_body(script_name):
    settings_home_script = (
        '${COORDINATOR_SETTINGS_HOME:-$HOME/.coordinator-claude-settings}/bin/'
        f'{script_name}'
    )
    return (
        "#!/bin/sh\n"
        '_PY=python3\n'
        f'_T="{settings_home_script}"\n'
        'exec "$_PY" "$_T" "$@"\n'
    )
